ns2:course.label: Interdisciplinary Pathways to Environmental Sustainability (Social Science)
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary Pathways to Environmental Sustainability (Social Science) is a multi-section Grand Challenge Learning pilot course in the Sustainability, Energy & the Environment pathway. Each section engages specific dimensions of Sustainability, Energy & Environment from an interdisciplinary perspective while meeting the Gen Ed criteria for Social Science. Each section emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, projects, design-based thinking, community-engaged scholarship, or field trips. Prerequisite: Restricted to first-time new freshman or first-year transfer students.
